---
# Page shown by GitHub Pages when an address does not exist.
# Quarto renders it to docs/404.html with links that work from any folder.
title: "Page not found"
---

```{=html}
<div class="not-found">
  <h2 class="section-title">Page not found</h2>
  <p>The page you are looking for does not exist or has moved.</p>
  <p class="action-list">
    <a href="/" class="button-outline">Go to the home page</a>
  </p>
</div>
```
